side_missions.title: The Heart of All Things
side_missions.description: The Cradle of Whispers — the mythical source of all whisper crystals. Aristotle has spent his entire career chasing legends, and this one is real. The crystal mountain pulses with an energy that makes his fur stand on end. Whatever he finds here will change everything.

objectives.description: Ascend the crystal mountain through its shifting passages
Reach the crystal heart at the mountain's core
Decide the fate of the crystal source

side_missions.title: Songs of the First
side_missions.description: The Guardians of the Cradle speak in riddles and crystal harmonics. They've watched over the whisper crystal source since before any faction existed. Aristotle needs to earn their trust and learn their secrets — or the crystal heart will remain forever beyond reach.

objectives.description: Pass the Guardians' trials of worthiness
Learn the true history of the whisper crystals
